text:
Security Policy and Architectural Constraints for Logic Flaw Prevention:
1. Server-Side State Verification: Explicitly validate all preconditions, invariants, and postconditions on the server prior to state advancement.
2. Non-relying Input Validation: Do not depend on client-side constraints; validate domain-level sanity of all incoming values before processing.
3. Workflow Invariant Enforcement: Maintain strict transactional state machines where transitions require cryptographic or session-bound proof of prior step completion.
4. Architectural Dependency Auditing: Formally model side effects between integrated services to prevent out-of-order cross-component execution.

metadata.title: Defensive Guidelines for Logic-Safe System Design
metadata.policy_scope: API Gateways, Workflow Orchestrators, State Machine Engines
metadata.enforcement_layer: Server-side controllers and domain model services

rule_constraints.invariant: All workflow transitions must explicitly verify completion of prerequisite states
rule_constraints.precondition: Input values must pass domain boundary and semantic integrity checks
rule_constraints.postcondition: Terminal states must transition atomically to prevent state re-entry

text: Authoritative Server-Side Pricing Invariant: Financial values such as item price, discount calculations, and currency rates must strictly originate from authoritative server-side storage or database lookups. Endpoints accepting user submissions for cart management must accept only product identifiers (e.g., product_id, quantity) and forbid client-controllable price parameters.

metadata.title: Server-Side Authoritative Pricing Enforcement

rule_constraints.invariant: order.total == sum(item.quantity * catalog.getPrice(item.id) for item in cart.items)
rule_constraints.precondition: All product pricing must resolve via internal catalog mapping at runtime

text: Cart Item Quantity Policy and Invariants: All transactional endpoints accepting product quantities must enforce domain-level input validation ensuring the quantity is a strictly positive integer (quantity > 0 and quantity <= max_allowed_limit). Subtraction or item removal must use dedicated removal endpoints (e.g., DELETE /cart/items/{id}) rather than negative delta inputs. Invariant check: At no point may cart.items[i].quantity <= 0 or cart.total < sum(catalog_price(item) * item.qty).

metadata.title: Strict Positivity Invariant for Transactional Quantities
metadata.policy_scope: Order Management, Cart Services, Inventory Controllers

rule_constraints.invariant: all(item.quantity > 0 for item in cart.items) and cart.total >= 0

text: Continuous Trust and Re-verification Policy Invariant: Any state mutation that updates identity or trust-determining attributes (such as email domain, company affiliation, or role) must enforce identical verification constraints across all application endpoints. If privilege derivation depends on domain validation, any update to that attribute must immediately revoke existing privileges and transition the account to an unverified state until domain ownership is re-proven via cryptographic or out-of-band verification.

metadata.title: Uniform Domain Validation and Re-Authentication Invariant

rule_constraints.invariant: user.is_admin == True iff user.email.domain == privileged_domain and user.email_verified == True
rule_constraints.precondition: All profile update endpoints must validate domain constraints and reset email_verified to False on address change
rule_constraints.postcondition: Privileged roles cannot be granted based on unverified, user-submitted identity strings

text: Stateful Discount Enforcement Invariant: A promotional discount code must be validated against a persistent, immutable set of all coupons applied to the active order (applied_coupons: Set[CouponID]), as well as historical user redemption records. Applying a coupon code requires that coupon_id not in order.applied_coupons and coupon.redemption_count < allowed_limit. Successive coupon applications must not overwrite or flush historical application tracking within the cart session.

metadata.title: Set-Based Unique Coupon Application Invariant

rule_constraints.invariant: len(order.applied_coupons) == len(set(order.applied_coupons)) and all(c.usage_per_order <= 1 for c in order.applied_coupons)
rule_constraints.precondition: submitted_coupon.id not in [c.id for c in order.applied_coupons]
rule_constraints.postcondition: order.total == max(0, catalog_total - sum(c.deduction for c in order.applied_coupons))

text: Safe Financial Arithmetic and Upper Bound Invariant: All financial aggregations, balance updates, and cart subtotal computations must employ overflow-safe math constructs (e.g., arbitrary-precision decimals, BigInteger, or language-level checked arithmetic). Systems must enforce upper saturation limits on line items and overall cart value before state persistence. Any operation that causes arithmetic overflow, underflow, or undefined numeric wrapping must immediately reject the state transition and terminate the transaction.

metadata.title: Arithmetic Bounds and Overflow-Safe Financial Accumulation

rule_constraints.invariant: cart.subtotal == sum(item.quantity * item.unit_price) and cart.subtotal <= MAX_SAFE_ORDER_LIMIT

text: Uniform String Boundary and Sanitization Policy: All layers processing sensitive identity attributes (web validation controllers, messaging queues, SMTP dispatchers, and persistence layers) must enforce identical length and format constraints. Database column definitions must either support the full RFC standard length (RFC 5321 specifies up to 254 octets for path/reverse-path) or reject inputs exceeding constraints outright with an error rather than silently truncating. Invariant: Input validation length check must be less than or equal to database column capacity (MAX_INPUT_LENGTH <= DB_COLUMN_CAPACITY).

metadata.title: Uniform Field Length Validation and Fail-Closed Persistence Invariant

text: Endpoint Segregation and Session Identity Binding Invariant: Privileged administrative overrides and self-service account modifications must be strictly decoupled into separate, role-gated endpoints (e.g., /admin/users/{id}/password vs /user/profile/password). Self-service identity state mutations must derive the target user context exclusively from the verified server-side session token, never from client-supplied request parameters. Endpoints requiring prior credential confirmation must enforce parameter presence and validity as a mandatory precondition before dispatching to lower-level services.

metadata.title: Strict Endpoint Separation and Non-Controllable Target Invariant

text: Stateful Workflow Transition Integrity Invariant: An application workflow represented by a Finite State Machine (FSM) must enforce strict sequence validation server-side. Terminal state execution ($S_{completed}$) must require verified, non-replayable, cryptographic or database-backed proof that all mandatory antecedent states ($S_{cart} \to S_{payment}$) transitioned successfully. Navigating to post-payment confirmation endpoints without an active, verified, and unconsumed payment token must terminate the session or return HTTP 400/403.

metadata.title: Strict State Sequence and Prerequisite State Verification Invariant

rule_constraints.invariant: state(order) == ORDER_CONFIRMED iff state(payment) == PAYMENT_CAPTURED and payment.order_id == order.id

text: Fail-Safe Defaults and Complete State Machine Invariant: In multi-step authentication and provisioning flows, the intermediate session state must default to minimum privilege (deny-all / uninitialized role). No access to protected application controllers must be granted until the final transition state ($S_{terminal}$) completes successfully and an explicit role assignment is confirmed. Premature termination or dropping of intermediate transitions must invalidate the intermediate session token rather than allowing access with unconstrained defaults.

metadata.title: Principle of Fail-Safe Defaults in Stateful Authentication Sequences

rule_constraints.precondition: all(step in completed_steps for step in required_auth_steps) == True

text: Promotional Scope and Valuation Invariant: Promotional coupons, percentage discounts, and marketing vouchers must strictly exclude cash-equivalent products, gift cards, stored-value certificates, and currency transfers from eligible subtotal calculations. Precondition: For any item in order.items where item.is_cash_equivalent == True, item.discount_eligible must evaluate to False. Invariant: The acquisition price of a stored-value instrument must never be lower than its redeemable face value when purchased using the same currency denomination or store credit system.

metadata.title: Cash-Equivalent Discount Exclusion and Face Value Invariant

text: Cryptographic Domain Separation and Authenticated Encryption Invariant: Cryptographic keys must never be shared across disparate application workflows or data sensitivity tiers. State tokens and encrypted cookies must enforce: 1) Unique, domain-separated subkeys derived via a Key Derivation Function (e.g., HKDF with explicit info contexts like 'auth-session-cookie' vs 'ui-notification'). 2) Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data (AEAD, e.g., AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305) to detect any ciphertext tampering, byte truncation, or block splicing before decryption. Invariant: Ciphertext produced in context A must fail integrity verification and be rejected outright if consumed within context B.

metadata.title: Cryptographic Key Domain Separation and AEAD Integrity Invariant

text: Canonical Email Address Parsing and Single-Parser Invariant: All application layers—input filtering, authorization policy evaluation, database persistence, and message transmission/MTA handoff—must employ an identical, authoritative RFC 5321/5322 parsing engine operating on fully normalized and canonicalized strings. Decouple delivery addresses from identity assertions: domain validation for access control must be executed against the terminal mailbox host extracted post-MIME-decoding, never against raw, unnormalized, or composite input strings. All obsolete or non-standard charset encodings (including UTF-7, raw escape sequences, or unexpected RFC 2047 headers in local-part contexts) must fail closed at the API boundary.

metadata.title: Canonicalized Single-Parser Email Domain Invariant

text: Email Domain Authorization and Single-Source Validation Policy: Never use email address domains as the sole means of authentication, authorization, or trust enforcement (such as verifying corporate identity or Cloudflare Zero Trust access gates), because email parsing standards, encodings, and legacy MTA behaviors allow arbitrary domain spoofing and splitting. Applications must disable encoded-word decoding within sensitive validation contexts or enforce strict regex validation (e.g., checking for '=[?].+[?]=') to reject non-standard MIME headers. All identities asserted via external Single Sign-On (SSO) providers or email channels must undergo continuous secondary verification.

metadata.title: Prohibition of Email Domain-Based Access Control and Defensive Normalization

rule_constraints.precondition: parse_email_address(input) must reject inputs matching '=[?].+[?]=', control characters, and unexpected Punycode malformations
rule_constraints.postcondition: enforce multi-factor verification independent of unvalidated email domain substrings

text: Policy and Invariants for Stateful Business Operations: 1) Strict State Traversal: The application state machine must enforce that state transition $S_n$ strictly requires validated completion of $S_{n-1}$. Unhandled transitions must fail closed (deny access). 2) Authoritative Pricing and Re-validation: Crucial parameters (e.g., price, quantity, roles) must be derived exclusively from server-side datastores and re-verified immediately prior to final settlement. 3) Resource Lock Lifecycles: Resource reservations must enforce bounded timeouts and atomic expiration controls to prevent denial-of-inventory or starvation attacks. 4) Transactional Rollback Atomicity: If a primary transaction state is cancelled or fails, all dependent side-effects (e.g., accrued reward points, store credits, voucher activations) must be atomically revoked within the same transactional boundary.

metadata.title: Stateful Transaction Integrity and Resource Reservation Policy

rule_constraints.state_transition_invariant: current_state == S_n iff prior_state == S_{n-1} and prerequisites_satisfied(S_{n-1}) == True
rule_constraints.pricing_invariant: order.billed_total == sum(item.quantity * catalog.price(item.id) for item in order.items)

text: Continuous Semantic Verification and Zero-Trust Inter-Service Handoff Policy: 1) Multi-Tier Validation Invariant: Every service, microservice, and downstream integration partner must independently validate the contextual and logical validity of incoming data before state progression. Data validated at the front-end or ingress gateway must never be treated as implicitly trustworthy across internal handoffs. 2) Authoritative State Verification: Transaction authorization must execute against real-time, authoritative server-side state rather than stale, cached, or batched data models. 3) Economic and Frequency Bound Invariants: Financial transfer endpoints must enforce minimum transaction thresholds and chargeback/fee caps to prevent asymmetric economic depletion (DDo$). Any transaction where transactional overhead exceeds transferred asset value must be blocked or routed to administrative approval.

metadata.title: Zero-Trust Data Handoff and Semantic Validity Invariant

text: Server-Side State Sovereignty and Production Debug Sanitization Policy: 1) Client State Distrust Invariant: Workflow control parameters (such as whether a discount has been claimed, user privilege tier, or workflow step completion) must be stored in tamper-proof server-side session stores or cryptographically signed state containers. They must never be accepted from client POST/GET parameters. 2) Debug Pipeline Exclusion: Development, debugging, and testing flags (such as test_mode, bypass_auth, debug) must be stripped from application binaries during production build pipelines. 3) Idempotency Invariant: Financial, gamification, and reward accrual operations must be strictly idempotent and validated against an immutable server-side audit log.

metadata.title: State Sovereignty and Production Hardening Policy

text: Server-Side Relational Integrity and Authorization Policy: 1) Non-Editable Field Invariant: Values marked as read-only, static, or hidden in client interfaces must never be consumed from incoming HTTP payloads; authoritative values must resolve strictly from server-side session contexts or canonical databases. 2) Relational Scoping Invariant: When an operation references a relational entity key (e.g., project_id, account_id), the server must evaluate whether user.has_access(entity_id) is True before dispatching the query. 3) Multi-Field Referential Sanity: Relational updates must execute atomic validation rules ensuring all interrelated fields are mutually consistent (e.g., marital_status == 'single' enforces spouse_name == null). 4) Log Artifact Protection: Audit trails and system logs must enforce append-only policies, cryptographic tamper-evidence, and strict isolation preventing modification by application-tier users.

metadata.title: Server-Side Relational Edits and Immutable Audit Logging Invariant

rule_constraints.server_side_authority: assert not request.contains('role') if not session.is_admin()

text: Constant-Time Processing and Transactional TTL Policy: 1) Constant-Time Execution Invariant: Identity authentication, token comparison, and cryptographic operations must execute within uniform time bounds regardless of parameter validity or lookup outcome, using dummy hashing operations on invalid accounts to normalize execution duration. 2) Strict Reservation Lifecycles: Any state transition placing exclusive locks on shared resources (e.g., inventory, seat allocations) must enforce an immutable Time-To-Live (e.g., $TTL \le 300s$), rolling back automatically on timeout. 3) Price Quote Freshness Invariant: Time-sensitive quotes must enforce explicit validity ceilings; checkout execution must assert $T_{current} - T_{quote} \le MaxQuoteDuration$, requiring mandatory re-quote and client acknowledgement upon expiration.

metadata.title: Constant-Time Verification and Transaction Expiration Invariant

text: Database-Backed Invocation Quota and Atomicity Policy: Functions linked to financial discounts, asset downloads, or operational rewards must enforce hard, database-backed atomic checks (e.g., conditional atomic updates or distributed locks). Precondition: Invocations must verify $user.usage\_count < quota.limit$ and assert that promotional tokens are in state 'ACTIVE'. Postcondition: Coupon status must transition to 'REDEEMED' or user counters must atomically increment prior to returning execution success. State resets must never be derived from client-driven navigation.

metadata.title: Atomic Quota Enforcement and Database-Level Lock Invariant

text: Workflow State Transition Integrity and Transactional Atomicity Invariant: 1) Atomic Settlement Invariant: Auxiliary benefits, reward allocations, and state elevations tied to a commercial transaction must not be finalized until payment settlement is confirmed; if the workflow aborts or tenders an altered amount, dependent assets must atomically roll back within the same transactional boundary. 2) Symmetric Lifecycle Validation: All validation policies, business rules, and constraints applied during entity creation must be applied equivalently to all modification, update, and append endpoints. 3) Strict Sequence Enforcement: State machines must enforce that transition $S_n$ is accepted only if verified, non-reusable proof of completion for state $S_{n-1}$ is present in the server-managed session context.

metadata.title: Transactional Atomicity and Symmetric Lifecycle Policy

rule_constraints.lifecycle_symmetry: validate_content(post.content) on update == validate_content(post.content) on create

text: Application-Layer Active Self-Defense and Misuse Containment Policy: Applications must implement holistic runtime misuse detection (e.g., OWASP AppSensor architecture). Invariants: 1) Anomaly Thresholding: A single authenticated session accumulating repeated business logic violations, access control failures, parameter duplications, or out-of-order state transitions within a moving time window must trigger an automated escalation policy. 2) Tiered Remediation Response: Minor misuse thresholds must enforce progressive request delays (tarpitting) or step-up authentication; critical misuse thresholds must immediately revoke the active session, lock the account, and emit high-priority security telemetry. 3) Contextual Telemetry: Security incident logs must record sanitized headers, payload structures, and state history upon detection of anomalous traversal patterns.

metadata.title: Application-Aware Self-Defense and Misuse Escalation Invariant

rule_constraints.misuse_escalation: if session.misuse_score >= CRITICAL_THRESHOLD: session.terminate() and account.lock()

text: Secure File Upload and Ingestion Policy: 1) Strict Extension Allowlist Invariant: Upload handlers must enforce a strict, definitive allowlist of permitted extensions derived strictly from business requirements; all unapproved extensions must be rejected fail-closed. 2) Multi-Tier Validation: File validation must inspect the file extension, verify the declared MIME type, and validate the internal content using magic byte / binary header inspection. 3) Storage Isolation and Renaming Invariant: Uploaded files must be renamed to randomly generated UUIDs, stripped of execution privileges (stored on non-executable mounts or S3/blob stores), and served exclusively with 'Content-Disposition: attachment' or under an isolated sandbox domain. 4) Archive Path Normalization: Decompression utilities must canonicalize internal file paths and reject any entry resolving outside the target destination root.

metadata.title: File Ingestion Validation, Storage Isolation, and Extension Allowlist Policy

text: Malicious File Upload Defense, Content Scanning, and Storage Isolation Policy: 1) Anti-Malware Pipeline Invariant: Every uploaded file stream must be scanned by automated antimalware/antivirus engines before persistence; infected or unrecognized executable payloads must be quarantined immediately. 2) Execution Neutralization Invariant: Uploaded files must never be saved within the web server execution root; storage must use non-executable dedicated object stores (e.g., S3 buckets, dedicated storage mounts with noexec flags). 3) Safe Archive Extraction: Archive extraction utilities must canonicalize internal file paths and abort if any entry resolves outside the designated sandbox root; decompression limits must cap maximum extracted byte volume and nesting depth. 4) Active Content Stripping: Permitted media and documents must be re-encoded or sanitized (e.g., stripping EXIF metadata, re-rendering images via graphics libraries) to neutralize embedded polyglots or malicious script tags.

metadata.title: Malicious File Upload Scanning, Isolation, and Archive Handling Invariant

rule_constraints.archive_traversal_check: assert not any('..' in entry.filename or entry.is_absolute() for entry in archive.entries)
